messages:
Maria S: Quick proposal — shift our weekly engineering triage/bug sync from 10:00am PT to 12:30pm PT starting next week. Rationale: better overlap with QA/product, fewer morning context switches, and more folks available for quick owner handoffs. Proposed agenda (30m):
- 15m: backlog + owner updates (one-line status per owner in pre-read)
- 7m: hotfix lane & oncall handoffs
- 8m: rotating deep-dive (design/RFC or tricky bug)

I will add a Notion pre-read template. Can folks weigh in on timing and the agenda?

Kevin L: I get the overlap benefit, but mornings are usually quieter for devs. Any chance we try 11:00am instead of 12:30? Or alternate slots every other week?

Ash P: 12:30pm works much better for QA and SRE on our side — we often have morning test runs. +1 for rotating deep-dive to keep it focused.

Jordan M: +1 to the pre-read idea. If owners leave one-line statuses (blocked/ok/needs-review) we can triage async faster. 30m seems reasonable for the first couple cycles; we can tighten later.

Olivia R: If we move to lunch-ish slot can product folks still make it? I can take QA owner every other week but want product to sign off on availability.

Maria S: Good point. I'll ping product separately. Jordan — I'll make the pre-read with a single line per owner (status + link to PR/issue). Kevin — alternating weeks (morning/afternoon) is a fair experiment; want to try that for 4 weeks and measure attendance. Anyone object?

Kevin L: I'm fine trying alternate weeks. If attendance drops for engineering, we revert.

oncall-bot: Reminder: Incident postmortem draft due Friday — avoid scheduling rotating deep-dive during active incident response windows.

Maria S: Thanks — noted. I will avoid deep-dive on incident weeks. I'll create the Notion pre-read: https://notion.so/rw/triage-pre-read and update the recurring invite to reflect the alternation (week A: 10am, week B: 12:30pm). Please add your 1-line owner status by Tues 10am each week.

Jordan M: Added my owners list in the pre-read.

Olivia R: Added QA rotation and confirmed alternating weeks work for me.

Maria S: Awesome, thanks. I'll update the calendar and send a short note to product asking them to confirm their availability for the 12:30 slot. If no objections by EOD we'll consider this the new cadence. :thumbsup:
